adversary: Classical probabilistic or quantum bounded-query attacker; no compromised owner RNG or witness endpoint
public_inputs: T funded synthetic-model commitments, scope, roots, metadata; secret and trapdoor independent uniform canonical F_p^8
oracles: Classical public chain reads; idealized coherent hash oracle only in explicitly quantum model; no witness oracle
query_work_budget: Q hash evaluations or coherent queries; explicit circuit/memory budget needed for concrete costs
targets: T independent unspent note secrets; not T lifetime deposits after spending
advantage_bound: Ideal secret-check oracle sensitivity min(1,T*Q/2^h) classically or O(min(1,T*Q^2/2^h)) quantum, h=8*log2(p). This is an optimistic attacker oracle: an unspent commitment alone does not expose a secret-only checker because trapdoor is unknown.
work_factor: Ideal any-target Grover work sqrt(2^h/T) only under the stated target-check oracle; distinct from a proved advantage bound for the actual note relation
source_assumptions: Canonical secret entropy; Grover quant-ph/9605043; ideal hash and target oracle assumptions
lifetime: Use peak reachable unspent target population and total query budget; never subtract log2(T) again after T is in advantage
decisive_task: Derive the exact verifier predicate for note theft with unknown trapdoor, then bound multi-target recovery or exhibit a relation-level attack

adversary: Adaptive depositor chooses two different valid note witnesses before deposit
public_inputs: Scope, parameter ID, denomination, commitment encoding, nullifier rule
oracles: Hash evaluations and local deposit/withdraw verifier; quantum hash oracle only under an explicit QROM model
query_work_budget: Q queries and memory M; distinguish offline collision search from N on-chain withdrawals
targets: One useful collision pair in same accepted scope with distinct nullifiers; arbitrary digest collisions are insufficient
advantage_bound: Ideal n-bit random-function unrestricted collision upper-bound shape O(Q^2/2^n) classical / O(Q^3/2^n) quantum; useful relation constraints may lower success; no such theorem established for exact H0/H5
work_factor: Generic birthday 2^(n/2), BHT 2^(n/3) oracle benchmark with memory/circuit assumptions; not certified hash strength
source_assumptions: BHT quant-ph/9705002, exact constrained-lane mode, canonical encoding, different valid nullifiers
lifetime: Q is total attack query budget; honest deposits do not supply a blanket extra T divisor for an attacker-chosen collision
decisive_task: Write two-copy note equations plus unequal nullifiers, then cost Groebner/resultant solving including fixed scope and feed-forward

adversary: Malicious prover/depositor claims a leaf not in any accepted root history
public_inputs: Root history, child order, levels, depth20, scoped leaf encoding and empty nodes
oracles: Chosen deposits, public authentication paths, proof verifier, hash queries
query_work_budget: Q total hashes, A adaptive proof submissions, L=20 path levels
targets: R accepted roots and their node locations; count attackable locations not raw hash invocations
advantage_bound: Reduction sought: Adv <= Adv_proof_forgery + sum over first divergent path-node useful second-preimage/collision advantages. No numeric bound without exact reduction and root-history model.
work_factor: Target-node preimage is not unrestricted collision work; random-function QROM multi-target estimates require identified target set
source_assumptions: Canonical ordered level-bound hashing, binding PCS, AIR relation correctness, accepted root freshness policy
lifetime: Lifetime root retention affects available targets; no second subtraction after a union over root/node targets
decisive_task: Extract first divergent node for each accepted false path and classify precisely collision versus second-preimage, including zero leaves

adversary: Malicious spender or chosen-note depositor seeks one note with two accepted nullifiers, or two notes sharing a nullifier
public_inputs: Spent set, scoped nullifier, note commitment, public root and statement
oracles: Hash evaluation, public spent-set reads, withdrawal verifier
query_work_budget: Q hash queries and A adaptive attempts
targets: Same-note alternate nullifier for theft; cross-note aliases may only cause denial of service
advantage_bound: For deterministic canonical N(scope,secret), same witness gives one nullifier. Alternate accepted nullifier requires relation forgery or nonbinding commitment/encoding. Different-note collision alone is not double-spend evidence.
work_factor: No attack work assigned before usefulness reduction; generic collision benchmark is a separate nonqualifying model
source_assumptions: Canonical field boundary, scope binding, proof public-input binding, deterministic nullifier encoding
lifetime: Unspent targets and spent-set denial-of-service exposure differ; no universal deposit-count adjustment
decisive_task: Reduce two accepted spends of one leaf to unequal commitment witnesses or AIR/proof failure; separately characterize alias denial of service

adversary: Adaptive malicious prover, classical public-coin IOP versus Fiat-Shamir adversary separated
public_inputs: Exact relation, committed matrices, statement, parameters, complete transcript grammar
oracles: Public verifier and hash/Fiat-Shamir oracle; coherent access only for a named QROM theorem
query_work_budget: A attempts, Q oracle queries, per-site commit/query grinding 16 bits in baseline
targets: False statements or adaptive attempts covered by chosen theorem; honest proof count is not automatically target count
advantage_bound: IOP modeled epsilon from UDR or conditional Johnson table. A*epsilon is only a union sensitivity if per-attempt bound holds conditionally for adaptive history. ROM/QROM transformation loss is unknown.
work_factor: -log2(epsilon) is not an exhibited attack exponent. Halving grinding credits is not a QROM reduction.
source_assumptions: Pinned p3-security; BCHKS25 2025/2055; actual batching mapping; supplied 120-bit field and 128-bit MMCS caps; unresolved 2024/1553 reference identity
lifetime: Do not both scale Q in a Fiat-Shamir reduction and blindly subtract log2(A); prove which budget is already counted
decisive_task: Select actual PCS theorem objects, review same-m applicability and round-by-round composition, then instantiate a named ROM/QROM reduction

adversary: Adaptive caller interleaves A/B halves from different proofs/statements or overwrites/replays continuation storage
public_inputs: A checkpoint, full statement/parameter/proof digests, lookup key, expiry and transaction state
oracles: Local stateful A/B verifier, continuation lookup, hash queries; no private user data
query_work_budget: Q digest queries and A interleaved transaction sequences
targets: Live continuation records; 32-byte indices are not 64-byte authoritative identities
advantage_bound: Desired Adv <= proof-forgery advantage + authoritative full-digest binding advantage + state-machine failure. The legacy overwriteable/hashed-record scheme does not supply this reduction automatically.
work_factor: Lookup-key collision cost alone neither proves nor refutes substitution if all authoritative values are compared
source_assumptions: Exact transcript-owner experimental state-machine version, full-width comparison, digest mode, root/payout/parameter bindings
lifetime: Active-record population, TTL and cumulative retry budget separately; replay invariants are deterministic not probabilistic
decisive_task: Enumerate A1/A2/B1/B2 substitution/replay/expiry sequences and prove accepted B binds exactly its A state and final payout

adversary: Chosen-statement classical or quantum distinguisher observing many honest proofs
public_inputs: Same public statement with two equal-length valid witness distributions, proof bytes, timings only if included explicitly
oracles: Chosen-witness challenge prover with fresh private randomness, hash oracle; no secret-mask seed oracle
query_work_budget: N proofs and Q distinguisher queries; correlated-witness and reset access must be specified
targets: One challenge bit across N proofs, not N preimage targets
advantage_bound: |Pr[D(view_w0)=1]-Pr[D(view_w1)=1]|; no numeric bound established. Configured hiding PCS and randomized proofs are not an indistinguishability proof.
work_factor: No entropy-to-security shortcut; toy statistical tests cannot certify zero knowledge
source_assumptions: HidingFriPcs masks, hiding input and FRI MMCS, unpredictable RNG, no mask reuse, quotient randomizer correlations, Fiat-Shamir simulation
lifetime: Hybrid N*epsilon only after a single-proof composable bound; repeated witnesses and reused seeds require separate treatment
decisive_task: Give simulator and rank/entropy accounting for every opening plus adaptive proof composition; synthetic deterministic test seeds remain explicitly nonprivate

adversary: Prover forges inner relation, outer verification circuit, or the statement linking them
public_inputs: Both parameter IDs, exact inner verifier, outer relation and public statement encoding
oracles: Both proof systems and their transcript oracles; independence/shared-domain assumptions stated
query_work_budget: Q_inner,Q_outer and A attempts, each with separate lifetime accounting
targets: Accepted composite false statement, not automatic product of inner and outer errors
advantage_bound: Desired Adv_composite <= Adv_inner + Adv_outer + Adv_link with named reductions/losses. An inner forgery can be wrapped by an honest outer prover; outer proof cannot repair inner weakness.
work_factor: Never add security bits from layers. Error-sum exponents are not work factors.
source_assumptions: Exact verifier circuit equivalence, public statement linkage, shared hash/Fiat-Shamir domain composition, witness privacy if aggregation occurs
lifetime: Budget each adversary once; honest outer generation after forged inner proof is not another independent hard event
decisive_task: Construct composite game and reduction including statement linkage before claiming soundness; no classical wrapper authorized in this research
